verified_facts: On 24 July 2024 the operator first recorded cancellation to 18:00 and later cancellation to 20:00.
A separate update cancelled Queue 6 from 20:00 to 22:00.
For 11 December, all queues were cancelled from 07:00 local until separate instruction.
Strong heat 11-15 July: 35-38 C in most oblasts.
Parts of south/east plus Poltava, Dnipropetrovsk and Kirovohrad: locally 40-41 C.
Official text warns of complications for utilities and energy enterprises.
Same public page reports a short technical interruption affecting part of Queue 4.
0.1 x 0.1 degree regular CDS grid; native resolution about 9 km.
CDS API requires a personal access token and acceptance of dataset terms before download.
